title: Sambhar
description: Toor dal and tamarind stew with sautéed vegetables and sambhar powder.
ingredients: Vegetables of choice: chopped onions, okra (lady's finger) or capsicum (bell pepper)
1 ½ cups Toor dal (split pigeon peas)

steps.title: Prepare tamarind water
steps.text: Soak the tamarind and rock salt in hot water for 1 hour. Mix well, extract the juice and discard the fibrous residue.

steps.title: Cook the dal
steps.text: Wash the toor dal twice. Pressure cook with adequate water for 5–6 whistles until soft.

steps.title: Sauté vegetables
steps.text: Heat oil in a frying pan. Add mustard seeds, dried red chillies, curry leaves, asafoetida and fenugreek seeds (if using). Add your choice of chopped vegetables and sauté well.

steps.title: Simmer the base
steps.text: Add 3 tablespoons of sambhar powder, the jaggery and the leftover dal cooking water to the tamarind extract. Bring to a boil and let it simmer for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Combine & finish
steps.text: Add the cooked, mashed toor dal to the boiling tamarind mixture. Mix well, let it simmer for 1 minute and turn off the heat.
